_comment: Recorded execution results, one key per row of availability.md that claims 'available, tested'.
SANDBOX-DOCS-0002 / F-D2-EVIDENCE-NOT-ROW-SPECIFIC: the previous version had a single shared
'linux_ci' bucket, so any one recorded run satisfied every Linux row. It does not any more:
a key belongs to exactly one row, generation fails if two rows share one, and every assertion
must name a node id or a named check together with the outcome that was recorded for it.
The pytest outcomes are taken from the per-test lane reports that run 33633469871 uploaded as
artifacts (tests/lanes/conftest_report.py writes them); they are reproduced in ci-lane-record.txt.
